caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, rectangular picture or mirror frame rendered in a reddish-brown color, resembling wood. The frame features a decorative, symmetrical, and scrolling design on the top and bottom edges, with pronounced curvilinear details. At the center of the top section, there is a carved, golden eagle with outstretched wings, positioned inside a circular open space. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige. The frame itself occupies the central portion of the composition, and the name "Arthur Johnson" is lightly written in the lower right corner of the image. The inner part of the frame, where an image or mirror would be placed, is left empty and is bordered by a beveled edge.
title: Mirror
